title: Condense compact-mode token variants and unify micro-elevation + color ramps
creator: Maya Chen
description: Rationalize the design token surface for the newly introduced compact mode. This ticket consolidates duplicate color ramp stops, reduces typography scale permutations, and defines a simplified micro-elevation (shadow) hierarchy suited for small-surfaces (tables, dense lists, compact buttons). Goals: reduce token count by ~25% for compact theme, improve contrast for small-text UI to meet WCAG 2.1 AA at typical small sizes, and standardize spacing/radius values so engineering can implement a single compact CSS theme. Work will coordinate with engineering to ensure runtime-friendly token names and with Product to validate on key surfaces (data tables, mini-cards, compact toolbar).
acceptance_criteria: Compact token set exported to Figma and tokens repo under compact/* namespace
Typography scale for compact mode reduced to 5 steps with explicit mappings to host tokens
Color ramps consolidated: primary/neutral/critical reduced to 4 stops with documented usage guidance
Micro-elevation layer set to no more than 3 levels optimized for 8px corner radiuses and 4 spacing steps
Automated contrast report (axe/pa11y) shows compliant contrast for body-small (12/13px) and label-small
Design handoff docs updated with migration notes and migration PR opened in tokens repo
comments: 2025-01-11 - Maya Chen: Kicked off discovery. Collected examples of current compact usage from Console (tables, quick-actions, compact-list). Noted many duplicate neutral steps used only once.

2025-01-16 - Lucas Park: Completed first pass mapping of existing tokens to proposed compact set. Dropped 'neutral-6' and 'neutral-7' in favor of recomputed 4-stop neutral ramp to improve pairing with small text.
2025-01-22 - Design review: Agreed to keep 8px, 6px, 4px radii only for compact components. Discussed impact on avatar and pill shapes; PM asked to keep pill minimum 20px height.

2025-01-30 - Accessibility audit (internal): Identified failures for label-small on neutral-3; updated color stop to increase contrast to 4.5:1. Marked transient engineering task to regenerate palettes with new LCH deltas.

2025-02-05 - Engineering sync (ENG-2012): Eng requested token names be normalized to compact.{token}.{role} (e.g., compact.fill.primary). Agreed to create a compatibility table mapping old token names to new keys.
2025-02-12 - PM feedback: Prioritize tables and compact buttons for beta rollout. Added automated visual regression snapshots to acceptance criteria.
2025-02-15 - Maya Chen: Uploaded final Figma file and exported JSON tokens. Opened PR in tokens repo. Leaving this ticket in In Progress until engineering merges and flags rollout done.
